pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark-brown regions exhibit smooth edge gradients and moderate angularity, forming non-uniform polygons. Spatial area is significantly larger on the upper flank and lower neck, with patch size decreasing and morphology becoming more ovoid toward the lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space mesh consists of continuous light-cream pathways. Junction nodes primarily connect three to four paths. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, narrowing slightly at intersections and maintaining continuity across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder, characterized by dense, short vertical hair clusters with soft pixel transitions against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) clinging to the dorsal ridge, mid-flank, and posterior flank, causing localized occlusions of the underlying pelage pattern.
